title: Almost-wise output multiset
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. The almost-wise output multiset consists of the elements of the almost-wise output list, with each element counted according to its multiplicity in that list.
caveat: The payload does not define the small-bias algorithm underlying the output list.
